title: v is wave-scoped in some countries: the same cluster gets a new id each round, with no crosswalk

summary: The issue's claim holds: GhanaLSS 1987-88 maps v: CLUST and GLSS renumbered (1xxx -> 2xxx), so v is wave-scoped with no crosswalk or declaration. The follow-up design note settles the premises: GLSS2 is a half-retained rotating panel (79<->79 bijection, lower bound), Ethiopia 2011-12->2013-14 is a cleaner 333->433 complete bijection (ea_id -> ea_id2, possibly shipped in Pub_ETH_HouseholdGeovars_Y2 -- unverified), Tanzania's 0% is the 2014-15->2019-20 extended-panel boundary and is NOT crosswalkable (131 non-bijective), the Mover sentinel is library-wide (transformations.py:507, mover_sentinel='Mover'), and Uganda is three defects of which only one is #942. Design: declare per wave BOUNDARY with two orthogonal fields (household_continuity, cluster_id_continuity) in the panel: block of a sampling.yml sibling (#793); warn at Country, not Feature; crosswalk out of scope.
